offline.title: You're offline
offline.description: This page needs an internet connection. It will load by itself as soon as you're back online, and your account and data are fine.

app.title: Square Share Dashboard
app.description: Manage your products, design your storefront, connect Stripe, and view analytics on Square Share.

payments.title: Payments
payments.subtitle: Your balance, payouts and Stripe connection.

recentOrders.title: Recent orders
recentOrders.empty: No orders yet. When checkout opens, completed purchases appear here.
recentOrders.emptyReady: No orders yet. Your first sale will appear here.

attention.title: Needs attention
attention.allClear: All clear. Nothing needs your attention right now.

twoFactor.label: Turn on two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: A code from your phone at sign-in, so a stolen password alone can't get into your store.

stripe.label: Connect Stripe to get paid
stripe.description: Payouts stay blocked until your account is connected.

legal.label: Accept the seller terms
legal.description: Read the Seller Agreement, Terms and Privacy drafts and accept them.
legal.descriptionUpdated: The terms changed since you accepted them. Read and accept the current version.
legal.descriptionTerms: Read the Terms of Service and agree to them.
legal.descriptionTermsUpdated: The Terms of Service changed since you agreed to them. Read and agree to the current version.

noBuyPath.label: {count, plural, one {{count} product with no way to buy} other {{count} products with no way to buy}}
noBuyPath.description: Add a buy link, or set a contact email under Settings so buyers can reach you.

noShipping.label: Add your shipping terms
noShipping.description: Physical products need shipping and returns terms before buyers see full details.

storefront.descriptionEmpty: Add a product to its grid to give it a page you can share.
storefront.descriptionNone: Pick a look, then add your products to its grid.

images.label: {count, plural, one {{count} product missing an image} other {{count} products missing an image}}
images.descriptionMultiple: Products without images look empty on your storefront.

flaggedOrders.label: {count, plural, one {{count} order to review} other {{count} orders to review}}
flaggedOrders.descriptionBoth: {disputed, plural, other {{disputed} disputed}}, {refunded, plural, other {{refunded} refunded}}.

noindexPages.label: Product pages blocked from search
noindexPages.description: {count, plural, =1 {One storefront has indexing turned off for its product pages.} other {{count} storefronts have indexing turned off for their product pages.}}

deadBlocks.label: {count, plural, one {{count} product slot pointing to a deleted product} other {{count} product slots pointing to deleted products}}
deadBlocks.description: These slots appear empty to visitors. Open the designer and remove or replace them.

toShip.description: Buyers are waiting on these. Pack them, then mark them shipped.

withdrawals.label: {count, plural, one {{count} buyer cancelled} other {{count} buyers cancelled}}
withdrawals.description: They are owed a refund within 14 days. Arrange the return, then refund the order.

paused.label: {count, plural, one {{count} product hidden from buyers} other {{count} products hidden from buyers}}
paused.description: {count, plural, one {Square Share paused or removed it. See why, and what to do next.} other {Square Share paused or removed them. See why, and what to do next.}}

restock.label: {count, plural, one {{count} product selling out soon} other {{count} products selling out soon}}
restock.descriptionSingle: At this pace "{title}" sells out in about {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
restock.descriptionMultiple: "{title}" goes first, in about {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.

checkoutRates.label: Set your delivery prices
checkoutRates.description: Buyers can't check out a physical product until a destination has both a rate and a country.
